notes: Modified cash basis city, FY ended 2023-09-30. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p6). Statement prints 'Transfer in' 4,062 inside Total revenues 1,014,163 and 'Transfers out' 4,062 inside Total expenditures 1,168,365 (General Fund to Keno Lottery Fund, matched on p12 and p26); recorded as transfers_in/transfers_out with includes on reported_totals. Taxes 295,129 split by tax type and Intergovernmental 361,321 split into its printed pieces, both summed from the fund budget schedules (p11-27), which tie exactly. Fund balances (beginning 830,447, ending 676,245, p6) are recorded as fund balance; cash is not printed as a single total (cash lines, investments and deficit pooled cash are separate on p5), so beginning/ending cash are null; investments 29,833 (2022: 26,509) from p5. No restatement or prior period adjustment is printed (beginning fund balance 830,447 and business-type net position 272,760 equal the 2022 figures). Business-type: proprietary funds statement, modified cash basis (p8-9); measure is net position, cash basis (cash assets less deficit pooled cash); receipts total = operating charges 270,873 + nonoperating 18,022. Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1-2); the governmental funds statement (p5) is not used because it shows the Park/Cemetery deficit pooled cash as a liability (totals 740,271 vs 676,245). Detail schedules present (all complete, none cut off): General Fund summary budget schedule (p10, superseded by the detailed receipts p11 and disbursements p12-14 schedules, so p10 lines are not in detail), Street (p15-16), Park (p17-18), Library (p19-20), Street Lights (p21), Amusement (p22), Cemetery (p23), Cemetery Perpetual Care (p24), Disposal Service (p25), Keno Lottery (p26), Debt Service (p27), ARPA (p28), Water (p29-30), Sewer (p31), Sewer Replacement (p32), Sanitation Fees (p33). Schedule lines with a budget but no actual amount are omitted. The General Fund disbursements schedule prints 'Transfers out' 4,062 inside general government other services and charges (p12); recorded as an other financing line with includes on the detail total.
